news.title: Museum, Reimagined
news.summary_en: With innovative changes to its gallery space, the Chazen Museum of Art offers a bold new perspective on what it means to showcase a collection of works.

news.title: Author Eliot Stein to deliver Go Big Read keynote Nov. 19
news.summary_en: The journalist and BBC Travel editor will take readers behind the scenes of “Custodians of Wonder: Ancient Customs, Profound Traditions, and the Last People Keeping Them Alive.”

news.title: FGLI Services makes the invisible, visible — and accessible — for first generation and limited income students
news.summary_en: The new office aims to connect UW students with mentorship opportunities, important resources and each other.
